abilities.description: Shii-Cho: The most basic lightsaber form all younglings learn. You have mastered the basics, and add +1 in personal combat to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} when using your lightsaber.

Ataru: [requires FORCE ENHANCEMENT and DEVOTANT in the Force] You are acrobatic in your attacks. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray} in personal combat, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit. Once per fight, when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3f5a834fa3fea5d1]{Gain Ground} by athleticism and lightsaber, take an automatic strong hit.

Soresu: You can reflect blaster bolts with your lightsaber. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} in this way, take -1 momentum. If you hit, mark progress. If you score a strong hit on this attack and immediately @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3129f4caa4754caf]{Take Decisive Action}, you may retain the value of one challenge die from your @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} action instead of rolling that die.
